about: Name Picker has no questions: it only picks names. 'intro' = the How to play slides students see before it starts.

intro.title: Name Picker
text: Kru picks one name at random.

intro.title: Everyone gets a turn
text: Nobody is picked twice until everyone has had a turn today.

intro.title: Be ready!
text: When your name comes up, answer the question.
A good answer can win points.
